assertions: All twenty required Phase 4 evaluation metrics have typed results.
Precision, recall, timing, segmentation, attribution, relation, quotation, propagation, and context metrics are source-traceable.
A metric with no applicable reference examples is disclosed as not applicable rather than assigned a favorable score.
Boundary matching uses an explicit collar and deterministic one-to-one matching.
Segmentation similarity uses canonical word ownership rather than text similarity.
Controlled references and evaluation reports are sealed, reloadable, and tamper-evident.
Stratified results preserve evidence class and do not imply natural-speech generalization.
limitations: Controlled fixture measurements do not establish general natural-speech accuracy.
Not-applicable results are not treated as zero or perfect performance.
